claims.claim: 24 speed sports bicycle with hand selector gear controller
claims.evidence: Witness only reports a road bicycle with rear derailleur/chain area visible; no readable gear count or hand shifter details in the provided observations.
No close-up or readable markings/material confirmation is shown; witness notes no brand/model text readable.
No speed rating/specs are shown in the observations; witness only describes appearance and visible drivetrain wear.

risks.risk: Gear system may not actually shift correctly (worn chain/cassette/derailleur, misadjustment).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing gear changes across all gears while pedaling, plus close-up of shifter/derailleur movement and chain engagement.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/possibly needing service (as not confirmed to shift smoothly).

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak or worn (pads/rotors/rims), affecting safety and rideability.
risks.proof: Clip showing brake lever bite test and a short stop test from low speed; close-up of brake pads/rim wear.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes condition unknown (as not confirmed safe).

risks.risk: Tire condition may be poor (sidewall cracks, punctures, low tread) beyond what the angle shows.
risks.proof: Clear photos of both tires (tread + sidewalls) and a close-up of any damage; include a quick spin showing wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires may need replacement (as not confirmed good).

risks.risk: Wheel health may be compromised (bearing play, rim dents, alignment issues) not visible from limited angles.
risks.proof: Video of wheel spin with side-to-side wobble check; close-up of rims for dents and hub/bearing play test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as wheel condition uncertain (as not confirmed true/aligned).

risks.risk: Frame may have hidden damage (cracks, dents, rust) not captured in the current shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints and stress points (head tube, bottom bracket area, seat tube, chain stays) plus any rust spots; include a light tap/inspection clip if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as frame condition unknown (as not confirmed crack-free).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (lights, lock, pump, pedals, bottle cage) could reduce value.
risks.proof: Full layout photo of everything included and a checklist of accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as only the bicycle is included (as accessories not confirmed).

proof_requests: Provide a clear photo of the shifters/hand selector and a shot showing the gear range (e.g., front/rear gear markings) to confirm the number of speeds.
Show a short video of riding/pedaling while shifting through all gears (front and rear if applicable).
Provide close-up photos of brake pads/rims and a clip demonstrating strong brake bite and stopping.
Send clear photos of both tires (tread depth, sidewalls) and any puncture/patch history if present.
Show wheel spin videos to check for wobble and bearing play; include close-ups of rims for dents.
Provide close-up photos of the frame at head tube, bottom bracket, seat tube, and chain stays to check for cracks/rust/dents.
List and photograph all included accessories (pedals, lights, lock, pump, bell, bottle cage) and confirm if any parts are missing.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a road bicycle and notes visible drivetrain use, but key functional/spec details (true speed count, shifting/brakes, tire/wheel/frame health) are not confirmed. Price it at the worst-case used condition until the requested proof is provided.
